caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical object, primarily rendered in shades of brown and gray, positioned against a plain, beige background. The central element of the object is a funnel-like structure at the top, which gradually narrows into a horizontal body. Attached to this body are four curved legs, two on each side, each ending in a rounded foot, giving the object a stable, raised stance. Protruding from one side of the body is a hand crank attached to one leg, indicating a manual operation feature. There are several screw-like knobs on the body, including two near the top of each side. The overall construction is metallic in appearance, with smooth surfaces and curved lines. The drawing is signed "Geo. C. Brown" in the bottom right corner, with additional small, faint writing below. The composition is centered, with the object presented at a slight angle to show both the crank mechanism and the funnel opening.
title: Cherry Stoner
